div.head: Af El. 46
div.ab: Ne onfoh þu næfre metsceattum, forðon þe hy ablændaþ ful oft wisra monna geþoht ⁊ heora word awendaþ.
Ne onfoh ðu næfre médsceattum, forðon hie áblendað ful óft wisra monna geðoht ⁊ hiora word onwendað.
Nec accipies munera que etiam excecant prudentes et subuertunt uerba iustorum.
Ne onfoh ðu næfre médsceattum, forðon hie ablendað ful óft wisra monna geðoht ⁊ hiora word onwendað.
Never receive bribes, for they often blind the thoughts of wise men and misdirect their words.
Niemals nimm du Lohngelder an; denn die verblenden gar oft weiser Männer Denken und verdrehen deren Worte.
Never accept bribes; for they very often blind the thinking of wise men and pervert their words.
